questions.question: Sami calls Mina: 'A patient with severe maxillary atrophy! What to do?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Severe atrophy often requires a combination of techniques.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan a sinus lift.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risks of the lateral window sinus lift?' Mina replies:
options: Perforation of the sinus membrane, infection, edema
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Complications are multiple but generally manageable.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take precautions.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the Summers technique in sinus lift?' Mina replies:
options: A crestal technique with specific burs
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The Summers technique is a minimally invasive crestal technique.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use this technique for small defects.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When to use tilted implants?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Tilted implants are a solution for areas with little bone.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use tilted implants in this case.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the All-on-4 technique?' Mina replies:
options: A total rehabilitation technique on 4 implants
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The All-on-4 technique allows total rehabilitation with 4 implants.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in this technique.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of short implants?' Mina replies:
options: Avoiding bone grafts and sinus lifts
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Short implants are a validated alternative to grafting techniques.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will offer short implants.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage severe peri-implantitis?' Mina replies:
options: Surgical debridement, disinfection, regeneration if possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Severe peri-implantitis requires a surgical approach.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat surgically.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is distraction osteogenesis in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: The use of osteogenic distraction to increase bone
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Osteogenic distraction is a technique to increase bone volume.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer to a specialist.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of one-piece implants?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'One-piece implants simplify the procedure.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use one-piece implants.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a screw fracture of the implant?' Mina replies:
options: Remove the fractured screw with specific instruments
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Screw fracture is a rare but manageable complication.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will remove the fractured screw.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a gum graft in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: A technique to increase gum volume around the implant
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Gum grafting improves aesthetics and peri-implant health.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will offer a gum graft.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risks of zirconia implants?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Zirconia implants have risks to be aware of.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the risks before offering.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is alveolar ridge preservation after extraction?' Mina replies:
options: A technique to fill the socket after extraction
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Alveolar ridge preservation prepares the site for an implant.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do alveolar ridge preservation.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an implant with insufficient primary stability?' Mina replies:
options: Remove the implant, increase diameter or length
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Insufficient primary stability compromises osseointegration.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will remove and reposition.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the immediate loading protocol?' Mina replies:
options: A validated protocol for selected cases with excellent primary stability
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Immediate loading is indicated in very selected cases.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will select cases carefully.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of conical connection implants?' Mina replies:
options: Mechanical stability and reduction of micro-movements
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Conical connection offers excellent stability.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use conical connection implants.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is combined grafting in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: The combination of several grafting techniques
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Combined grafts are sometimes necessary for complex cases.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan a combined approach.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient at high risk of peri-implantitis?' Mina replies:
options: Enhanced maintenance protocol and risk factor control
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'High-risk patients require closer follow-up.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan close follow-up.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is guided surgery in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: A technique using a surgical guide for precise placement
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Guided surgery offers millimeter precision.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always use guided surgery.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of hydrophilic surface implants?' Mina replies:
options: Improved osseointegration and reduced healing time
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Hydrophilic surfaces accelerate osseointegration.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use hydrophilic surface implants.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is prosthetic design on implants?' Mina replies:
options: The planning of the prosthesis that will be fixed on the implant
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Prosthetic design is essential for the final result.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan the prosthesis before the implant.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with diabetes and an implant?' Mina replies:
options: Strict glycemic control and enhanced follow-up
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Diabetes must be controlled for implant success.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will coordinate with the treating physician.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a biopsy in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: A bone sample for histological analysis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Biopsy is sometimes necessary to diagnose lesions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer to a stomatologist.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the signs of long-term success of an implant?' Mina replies:
options: No pain, no mobility, physiological bone loss
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Long-term success is measured by stability and health.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will follow my patients long-term.'

questions.question: Sami, after facing complex implantology cases with Mina, says: 'I am proud of our successes!' Mina concludes: 'Advanced techniques are...'
options: The key to rebuilding the smile
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Advanced techniques are the key to rebuilding the smile.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to improve.'
